class.name: X25519
class.brief_description: Pure X25519 (RFC 7748) ephemeral key agreement primitives.
class.description: Provides fresh ephemeral X25519 (Curve25519) keypair generation and raw Diffie-Hellman. These keys are independent from Ed25519 keys; this addon never converts between the two. Intended for ephemeral key agreement. The shared secret returned by [method shared_secret] is [b]raw and unhashed[/b] - never use it directly as a cipher key; feed it through a KDF (e.g. [Monocypher.blake2b] with a domain-separation string) at the protocol layer.

method.name: generate_keypair
method.description: Generates a fresh ephemeral X25519 keypair. The private key is 32 random bytes from the platform CSPRNG; the public key is [code]crypto_x25519_public_key(sk)[/code]. Clamping is performed inside the underlying primitive. Returns null and pushes an error if the CSPRNG fails.

method.name: shared_secret
method.description: Computes the raw RFC 7748 Diffie-Hellman shared secret from a 32-byte [param own_private] scalar and a 32-byte [param their_public] u-coordinate. Returns the 32-byte shared secret as a [PackedByteArray], or null if the result is all-zero (low-order point - must abort) or the inputs are not 32 bytes. The zero check is constant time. Do not use the raw secret directly as a cipher key.
